name: move_selected_object_to_position_by_step_distance

stack.evidence: func_001D2CA0 consumes step distance, X, Y, and Z, snapshots the selected object's current position, stores the target coordinates and per-update step distance in Script movement state, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: func_001D2CA0 sets Script update flag 0x40. While set, func_001D2AF0 advances the selected object toward the requested coordinates by the supplied distance per update, applies each intermediate position through func_001C5DE0, and clears the task when the target is reached. Unlike command 280 move_selected_object_to_position_at_speed, this command does not divide its first argument by the 50 Hz update rate. The JP corpus contains 85 calls.
